topics.topic: Nhazi Ahịrịokwu Igbo: Ahịrịokwu mfe, ahịrịokwu nchikọta na ahịrịokwu mgbagwoju anya
learningObjectives: Ịkọwa ihe bụ ahịrịokwu na usoro njikọ ya n'Igbo
Ịmata ọdịiche dị n'etiti ahịrịokwu mfe na nke nchikọta
Iji njikọokwu mepụta ahịrịokwu mgbagwoju anya doro anya

topics.topic: Ụdị Ahịrịokwu Dịka Ọrụ Ha Si Dị: Nkwupụta, Ajụjụ, Iwu na Mkpọku
learningObjectives: Ịkọwapụta ụdị ahịrịokwu anọ dịka ọrụ ha si dị na nkwurịta okwu
Iji akara ajụjụ na akara mkpọku n'ahịrịokwu kwesịrị ekwesị
Ịgbanwe ahịrịokwu nkwupụta ka ọ bụrụ nke ajụjụ ma ọ bụ nke iwu

topics.topic: Omenaala Ịkwa Ozu na Olili n'Ala Igbo: Ozu ndị agadi na ozu ndị gburu onwe ha
learningObjectives: Ịkọwa usoro e si akwa ozu okenye dịka ikwa ozu, ịgba egwu, na inye nri
Ịmata ihe ndị Igbo na-eme n'ebe onye gburu onwe ya nọ (arụ na olili n'ajọ ọhịa)
Ịkọwa nkwenye ndị Igbo banyere ndụ mgbe anwụsịrị na ilo ụwa

topics.topic: Agụmagụ Ederede maka Ule BECE: Akwụkwọ akụkọ na njikọ atụmatụ okwu
learningObjectives: Ịgụ akwụkwọ akụkọ Igbo a kwadoro maka ule BECE
Inyocha atụmatụ okwu dịka myiri, mmetọ, egbeokwu na akpụrụokwu
Ịkọwa etu odeakwụkwọ siri gosipụta omenala n'ime akwụkwọ ya

topics.topic: Edemede Nkwurịta Okwu / Arụmarụ: "Ọrụ Ugbo Ka Ọrụ Ọfịs Mma"
learningObjectives: Ịmata usoro na iwu dị na edemede arụmarụ ụka
Ikwado echiche nke ha site n'inye ezi ihe akaebe doro anya
Igosipụta nkwanye ùgwù na ịkwanyere ndị na-emegide echiche ha ùgwù

topics.topic: Usoro Ọchịchị Ọdịnala n'Ala Igbo: Eze, Igwe, Ndị Nze na Ọzọ, na Òtù Ọgbọ
learningObjectives: Ịkọwa usoro ọchịchị onye kwuo uche ya n'ala Igbo oge ochie
Ịkọwa ọrụ Eze ma ọ bụ Igwe na ndụmọdụ ndị nze na ọzọ
Ịmata ọrụ dị mkpa òtù ọgbọ na-arụ na mmepe obodo na nchekwa

topics.topic: Nlele Nnwale Nke Etiti Oge na Nleba Anya maka BECE
learningObjectives: Inyocha ogo nkwadebe ụmụakwụkwọ maka ule ikpeazụ nke BECE
Idozi nsogbu dị n'ahịrịokwu na edemede arụmarụ
Inye ndụmọdụ pụrụ iche maka ụmụakwụkwọ niile

topics.topic: Njikọokwu na Nnọchianya: Ojiji ha na ịtụ asụsụ ọnụ
learningObjectives: Ịmata njikọokwu dị iche iche dịka 'ma', 'kama', 'n'ihi na', 'tupu'
Iji nnọchianya mee ka ahịrịokwu ghara inwe nkwughachi okwu na-enweghị isi
Igosipụta nghọta miri emi n'usoro ụtọasụsụ

topics.topic: Egwuregwu Ọdịnala na Egwu Ọdịnala Ndị Igbo
learningObjectives: Ịkpọpụta egwuregwu ọdịnala dịka ịgba mgba, ịchụ nta, na ịzụ ahịa mbe
Ịkọwa mkpa egwu mmanwụ, ekwe, na ogene dị n'emume ọdịnala
Ịmata etu egwuregwu ndị a si akwalite ahụike na ịdị n'otu

topics.topic: Ịmepụta Mkpụrụokwu Ọhụrụ n'Asụsụ Igbo maka Sayensị na Nkà na Ụzụ
learningObjectives: Ịkọwa usoro e si emepụta okwu ọhụrụ (ịkpọgharị, nchikota, ntụgharị)
Ide mkpụrụokwu sayensị dịka kọmpụta (ngwa elektrọnik na-edozi ozi)
Ịkwalite asụsụ Igbo ka o nwee ike ịsọ asọmpi n'ụwa ọgbara ọhụrụ

topics.topic: Nsọala na Arụ n'Ala Igbo: Iwu obodo na ihe mgbochi
learningObjectives: Ịkọwa ihe nsọala pụtara na ihe mere obodo ji asọ ha
Ịkọwa ihe a na-eme ma mmadụ mee arụ (ịkwụ ụgwọ, ịchụ àjà nchụpu)
Inyocha uru nsọala na-abara nchekwa na ịdị ọcha nke gburugburu ebe obibi

topics.topic: Nchịkọta Gburugburu na Nkwado Pụrụ Iche maka Ule BECE / JSCE
learningObjectives: Inyocha usoro ajụjụ ule BECE niile gbasara asụsụ Igbo
Idozi ajụjụ nlereanya nke afọ gara aga na-enweghị njehie
Ịgba ụmụakwụkwọ ume ka ha nwee mmeri n'ule ikpeazụ

topics.topic: Ule Ọgwụgwụ Oge na Nnwale Nleba Anya BECE
learningObjectives: Inye ule dịka usoro na ụkpụrụ NERDC na Ministry of Education siri dị
Iji ụkpụrụ akara kachasị elu gbaa akara
Idebanye akara na akwụkwọ nchịkọta maka nkwado ikpeazụ
